passwordReset.subject: AgroTrace: password reset
passwordReset.body:
Hello, {fullName}!

We received a request to change your AgroTrace password. To set a new password, open the link:

{link}

The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once. If you did not request a password change, just ignore this email.

invite.subject: AgroTrace: invitation to {organizationName}
invite.body:
Hello!

You have been invited to {organizationName} in AgroTrace. To accept the invitation, enter your full name and set a password via the link:

{link}

The link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
